summary: E2E test of new 'Tirage Complet 78 cartes'. Backend: 6/6 pytest pass (nb_cartes 3/5/7 -> exact length, is_major bool, majors+minors==nb, unique cards, interpretations >50 chars, AI enrichment applied (0 'enrich skipped' logs), response 19-24s < 55s, invalid nb falls back to 5, PDF type=complet 200 3.55MB %PDF with filename tirage-complet-78-plume-astrale.pdf, empty data -> 400). Frontend (Playwright, demo account): login OK, /tirage-tarot -> /services/tarot, gate unlock, select-marseille/celtique/complet visible, nb-cartes-3/5/7 sub-selector appears, 5-card draw displayed in 20.9s, reveal-all + voir-synthese OK, 5 synth-complet-carte-* blocks, Tendance générale + conseil rendered, PDF download filename tirage-complet-78-plume-astrale.pdf, btn-nouveau-tirage returns to step 1 (no gate, question empty, selectors visible), second Marseille draw OK with only 1 /api/credits/use call in the whole session (session-unlimited works).

minor.issue: No auth/credit check server-side: endpoint is fully public, credit gate is client-side only. Anyone can call it (and burn LLM budget) without paying.

ui_bugs.issue: Gate shows 'Coût : 10 crédits' / 'Utiliser 10 crédits' and blocks if balance < 10, but backend config lecture_tarot = 5 credits (review says 5). Price display/threshold inconsistent with real debit.

integration_issues.issue: first_name sent is user.email.split('@')[0] -> AI text addresses user as 'Concours' instead of profile first name 'Camille'. Same for PDF prenom.

issues: Minor-arcana thumbnails in the synthesis recap row render as empty gold frames (no image, no fallback symbol) — looks broken; add a fallback (symbole/suite/couleur) for minors.
'Créer un compte' CTA still shown while logged in as Camille.

action_items: Align credit gate cost text/threshold (10) with backend lecture_tarot cost (5) in TirageTarot.js
Send profile first name (not email prefix) as first_name/prenom to /api/tarot/complet and /api/tarot/pdf
Add visual fallback for minor cards without images in synthesis recap (and step 2 reveal)
Consider server-side verification (token + session unlock) on /api/tarot/* to prevent unpaid usage
Hide 'Créer un compte' header CTA for authenticated users
critical_code_review_comments: TirageTarot.js reveal loop uses nbCartes78 state for maxCards instead of tirageData.cartes.length — safer to derive from response
TirageTarot.js is 928 lines (>700) — split into components (selector, reveal grid, synthesis)
Credit unlock is purely React state: page refresh loses paid session (by design but worth noting); backend endpoints trust client
